turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: Your Majesty, I appreciate your candor. Please proceed with your case.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I have come to you, Mr. Holmes, to seek your assistance in retrieving a cherished item that was once entrusted to a lady of the court, but has now fallen into the wrong hands. This item, a portrait, holds the key to my peace of mind and the stability of my kingdom.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: Your Majesty, I understand the gravity of this matter. Mr. Holmes, we must approach this delicately.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: Very well, Your Majesty. I shall require a detailed account of the circumstances surrounding this portrait and the individual to whom it was entrusted.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: The portrait in question was entrusted to a lady of the court, whom I once loved dearly. However, our relationship has since cooled, and the portrait, which bears my likeness, has become a symbol of the past. I fear that its current holder may use it against me, both personally and politically.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: Holmes, we should consider the political ramifications of this case. The portrait's return could prevent a diplomatic incident.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: I see the gravity of the situation, Your Majesty. Let us proceed to the facts and leave conjecture aside.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: Indeed, Mr. Holmes. The portrait is not merely a likeness but a symbol of my youth and folly. I must retrieve it before it causes irreparable damage to my reputation and my kingdom.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: Holmes, given the delicacy of the matter, we must ensure that our methods are both discreet and effective.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: Let us begin by establishing the exact circumstances under which the portrait was entrusted. The timing and the individuals involved are crucial.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: My dear Holmes, your incisive approach is reassuring. The portrait was entrusted to the care of a lady, a lady who has since become... less than amiable towards me. The circumstances were... delicate, to say the least.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: Indeed, Your Majesty. The lady in question may hold the key to resolving this matter. I will ensure that we handle the situation with the utmost discretion.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: The lady in question, Your Majesty, will indeed prove to be a critical link. Dr. Watson, we must gather more information on this lady and the nature of her relationship with the portrait.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: Holmes, your astuteness is unparalleled. I am fully aware of the delicacy of the situation and trust your discretion implicitly. The portrait in question is of great sentimental value, but the lady in possession of it is a matter of considerable political concern.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: Holmes, it would be wise to discreetly inquire about the lady's background and current sentiments towards the King. We must be cautious not to cause any undue alarm.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: Indeed, Dr. Watson. I appreciate your caution. Should Holmes discover the lady's location, we must proceed with the utmost delicacy. My kingdom's peace hangs in the balance.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: My dear Watson, Your Majesty, the next step is clear. We must ascertain the lady's current whereabouts and situation without delay. I propose we visit her residence immediately.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I concur with your plan, Holmes. Let us proceed forthwith, but remember, the utmost secrecy is imperative. Should any hint of this matter leak, the consequences could be dire.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: Very well, Holmes. We shall proceed with all due haste and caution. Your Majesty, I trust we can rely on your discretion as well.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: Let us be off then, Your Majesty, Watson. Time is of the essence.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: You had my note? I told you that I would call.

opening.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
opening.text: Pray take a seat. This is my friend and colleague, Dr. Watson, who is occasionally good enough to help me in my cases. Whom have I the honour to address?

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: You may address me as the Count Von Kramm, a Bohemian nobleman. I understand that this gentleman, your friend, is a man of honour and discretion, whom I may trust with a matter of the most extreme importance. If not, I should much prefer to communicate with you alone.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: Then I must begin. I must bind you both to absolute secrecy for two years; at the end of that time the matter will be of no importance. At present it is not too much to say that it is of such weight it may have an influence upon European history.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: You will excuse this mask. The august person who employs me wishes his agent to be unknown to you, and I may confess at once that the title by which I have just called myself is not exactly my own.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: The circumstances are of great delicacy, and every precaution has to be taken to quench what might grow to be an immense scandal and seriously compromise one of the reigning families of Europe. To speak plainly, the matter implicates the great House of Ormstein, hereditary kings of Bohemia.

opening.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
opening.text: I was also aware of that.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: If your Majesty would condescend to state your case, I should be better able to advise you.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: You are right. I am the King. Why should I attempt to conceal it?
